description: The app's own pages (served by riven's Node process on 127.0.0.1) may move their window (drag regions, the title bar double-click), call riven's Rust commands (the generated set rust-main) and listen for the events Rust sends them. Scoped by webview label (app windows are w<n>, dockview popouts pop-<id>) so the browser panel's pages (bv-<n>), which share their window, get nothing.
